proxy_reward_note: ARS is gradient-free — it does not backpropagate through the reward. The proxy serves as the fitness signal for perturbation selection. Agents are NOT trained on the satisfaction term directly.

ars_specific_notes.n_top_leq_n_delta: n_top is clipped to min(n_top, n_delta) in build_model to ensure validity
ars_specific_notes.convergence_note: ARS converges more slowly than gradient-based methods by design. Optuna convergence curves may not plateau within 30 trials.
ars_specific_notes.vecnorm_role: VecNormalize normalises observations only. ARS uses this for policy input scaling, not for gradient computation.

vecnorm_freeze: VecNormalize stats frozen after training (training=False, norm_reward=False) before ALL evaluation episodes.
optuna_asymmetry_note: F2 searches same 30 trials as F1 but across 3 additional YAML dims (spawn_multiplier, discharge_price_factor, transformer_max_power). F2 HPs may be less well-tuned per dimension.
mpc_horizon_note: EV2Gym paper MPC uses horizon=25 steps (Table VII). Our reproduced variant could not match that config — treated as a distinct controller.
paper_ref_note: ARS results exist in Table VII: profit=17.7±9.9 EUR, sat=53±11%, overload=36±67 kWh. Values in paper_ref are confirmed correct.
single_scenario_note: All results are from the workplace scenario only.
statistical_note: High std relative to mean expected in Phase 2. Pairwise differences may not be statistically significant without bootstrap CIs / Wilcoxon tests.
